label: Code Walkthrough
description: Draft portrait package for readable code explanations, semantic diffs, API sequences, debugging traces, and terminal-to-code comparisons.

renderCost.notes: Two fixed portrait surfaces and lightweight frame-driven entrances.

reducedMotion.notes: Reduce and static policies preserve layout and use only restrained entrances.

accessibility.notes: High contrast code, fixed line gutters, textual diff markers, and a caption-safe surface.

directorCompatibility.selectionReason: Use when source code or an execution trace is the primary evidence.
hardBlocks: Registration remains pending outside this package ownership.

sourcePolicy.notes: Draft implementation uses local fixtures and Lucida shared primitives. No source approval or pattern claim is made.

tokens.palette: neutral charcoal with cyan focus, green additions, red removals, and amber warnings
tokens.typography: UI sans for explanation and system monospace for code
tokens.surface: fixed line geometry with low-radius code panels

layoutGrammar: Keep code as the dominant readable surface.
Use fixed line-number and semantic-marker gutters.
Use plus and minus markers with color for diffs.
Reserve a stable lower caption-safe panel.
Do not animate layout dimensions or line positions.

componentPrimitives.notes: Fixed code lines, line numbers, and semantic markers.
Ordered review state or sequence context.

knownLimitations: This draft is not registered for runtime selection.
No source approval or visual-pattern claim is included.
